newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Harbor spot jet fuel softens on ample supply.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Harbor spot jet fuel softens on ample supply.

text.p: New York Harbor jet fuel spot prices continued soft Wednesday where they were expected to remain for the next several weeks due to high refinery run rates, said traders.
NYH spot 55 was traded at 1.00 cent over the June NYMEX futures, 0.25 cent off Tuesday's level.

"We are going to see soft jet prices for the next three weeks. Refiners will continue to run above 93 percent for a while, and until we see evidence that rates are falling, there will be plenty of product supply," said a jet fuel dealer.
Tuesday evening, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said the refinery utilization rate stood at 97.6 percent for the week ended May 16, up from 96.9 percent the week before.
NYH prompt 54-grade traded 0.50 cent over the June NYMEX futures just as it had Tuesday in thin dealings, a level that was a penny down from last week.
